task: Compare actual 115/230V candidate ratios in the requested 120/220V modes before selecting transformer, reservoir or U4. No native adoption.
line_basis: Engineering +/-10% screen around each requested nominal mains voltage, not a claimed local statutory supply tolerance or transformer operating approval.

replacement_U4.iq_basis: 8.5mA over temperature plus1mA line and0.5mA load changes; conservative arithmetic screen within specified conditions.

limits: Transformer regulation is typical, not bounded. Resistive equivalent derived from nominal loaded voltage/current; not measured DCR or an electromagnetic model.
Actual core flux, primary tolerance, mains switching and fault protection are not qualified by secondary scaling.
1000/4700uF comparison uses the minus20% capacitance corner only, with the old assumed ESR. Exact capacitor, plus-tolerance/inrush, ripple, lifetime and size need separate checks.
Existing logic/audio reserve profiles are not proven actual maximum loads.
No socket/footprint, heatsink, supplier stock or Shanghai delivery approval.
